version.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

llm.summary: The skill is mostly aligned with image-generation automation, but it asks for broad command, file, browser-session, and external-send authority without tight scope or clear user controls.

dimensions.detail: Read/write/exec plus browser and desktop automation are plausible for the workflow, yet overbroad for many image-generation tasks and not limited to specific commands, directories, or operations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a pure Markdown skill with no executable bundled scripts, but it declares read/write/exec tools and references automatic installation of desktop-agent via uvx for browser/desktop automation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: External Feishu sending, callback_url/webhook behavior, browser automation using a logged-in Grok session, and desktop automation are disclosed, but the instructions do not clearly require per-destination confirmation, dry-run behavior, or tight boundaries before transmitting images, prompts, paths, or metadata.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill mentions prompt history, reusable templates, scheduled execution, webhook triggers, and retries, but does not include code that establishes persistence or background workers in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is batch Grok image generation, saving, post-processing, and distribution, but the skill also broadly frames itself for generic efficiency, automation, workflow optimization, file handling, API integration, information retrieval, and command execution.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with an agent using local file writes, command execution, browser/desktop automation, your logged-in Grok session, and optional Feishu or webhook delivery. Keep outputs in a dedicated directory, confirm any external destination before sending, and avoid using it with sensitive prompts or private images unless you have reviewed the workflow.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] expected: Exec access is coherent with post-processing and workflow scripting, but the artifact only gives general whitelist advice and does not define an actual command allowlist or input-safety boundary.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad activation language for generic automation and workflow optimization is wider than the image-generation purpose and can route the skill into unrelated tasks.
[SQP-2] expected: Feishu and callback/webhook integrations fit the distribution workflow, but the artifact under-discloses what content and metadata may be sent externally and lacks explicit opt-in controls.
